_comment: 24-HOUR HEIST. Max game length is 24h from launch. 14 hidden glyphs.
Each step reveals `reveal` hidden glyphs (default 1), in the fixed order chosen by gen/generate.js (position 0 is last).
deadline: relative to launch ('+2.5h', '+90m', '+24h') or absolute ISO. EVERY hidden glyph is time-locked (drand tlock)
to its step's deadline, so the reveal is GUARANTEED at that deadline even if the creator disappears. A milestone can only
make a step happen EARLIER, never later. The drip is ~one glyph every ~2.5h early and denser in the last ~6h, so by ~hour 23
only ~4 glyphs remain (trivially crackable on a normal PC) and at +24h the final glyphs (incl. position 0 / full seed) open.
milestone.mcapUsd: market cap held CONTINUOUSLY for milestoneRule.windowMinutes on >= minSources independent sources.
The sum of all `reveal` values must equal startHidden (14).

milestoneRule._note: Short game => short sustained window: 12 min continuous on >=2 independent sources, no gap > 4 min. Wash/one-block spikes can't trigger it.

steps.label: Vault opens: final glyphs + full seed
